promise: Pichai said Google aimed to run its operations on carbon-free energy everywhere, at all times, by 2030.
description: Google targets carbon-free electricity for its operations by 2030. Its 2025 report says 2024 total emissions increased 11% while hourly carbon-free-energy use rose from 64% to 66%. Those metrics describe different scopes.
evidence: Pichai's September 14, 2020 post supports the 24/7 operational-energy goal.
Google's 2025 report says 2024 total emissions rose 11% while hourly carbon-free energy reached 66%.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the 2030 target remains future and these are progress indicators with different scopes.

promise: Microsoft will be carbon negative by 2030
description: Microsoft announced its carbon-negative-by-2030 goal on January 16, 2020, alongside a longer-term historical-emissions goal. Its 2024 report says FY2023 Scope 1-3 emissions were 29.1% above the 2020 baseline. The 2030 deadline remains future.
evidence: Microsoft's January 16, 2020 announcement supports the carbon-negative goal.
Its 2024 report gives FY2023 emissions 29.1% above the 2020 baseline.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the 2030 target remains future; the report is progress evidence.

promise: Apple will be 100 percent carbon neutral for its supply chain and products by 2030
description: Apple announced on July 21, 2020 a plan for carbon neutrality across its business, manufacturing supply chain and product life cycle by 2030. Its plan combined a 75% emissions reduction with carbon removal for the remainder.
evidence: Apple's July 21, 2020 release supports the lifecycle goal and its reduction/removal approach.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the 2030 target remains future; the announcement is not proof of completion.

person: Sultan Al Jaber and Simon Stiell
role: COP28 President and UNFCCC Executive Secretary
promise: They called for tripling global renewable-energy capacity and doubling the rate of energy-efficiency improvement by 2030.
description: Their joint call set global 2030 objectives. COP28's stocktake subsequently called on parties to contribute to these objectives; adopting the text did not itself achieve them.
evidence: The July 27 joint statement supports the targets and date.
The December 13 COP28 summary supports their inclusion in the outcome.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the target year remains future and negotiating adoption is not measured delivery.
sources: UNFCCC Stiell and Al Jaber joint statement

person: World Health Organization (cervical cancer elimination strategy)
promise: Meet 90-70-90 cervical cancer elimination targets by 2030
description: WHO's cervical-cancer elimination strategy was adopted in August 2020 and launched in November. Its 2030 goals cover 90% HPV vaccination of girls by age 15, 70% screening of women by age 35 and again by 45, and 90% treatment or management of cervical disease.
evidence: The official strategy sets 2030 vaccination, screening and treatment targets; full achievement remains prospective.

promise: Finance and facilitate $1 trillion in sustainable finance by 2030, including $500 billion in environmental finance and $500 billion in social finance
description: Citi announced the goal on April 15, 2021, expanding its earlier $250 billion environmental-finance commitment. The target counts financing and facilitation from 2020 through 2030, with environmental and broader social categories.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the source establishes the 2020-2030 financing-and-facilitation target, but the original cumulative total was not reconciled to the latest report's tables.

promise: Achieve carbon neutrality across Tencent's own operations and supply chain by no later than 2030, with 100% green power by 2030
description: Tencent announced its operations-and-supply-chain carbon-neutrality target on February 24, 2022, together with 100% green electricity by 2030. Its mid-term report says green electricity rose from 22.0% in 2024 to 48.5% in 2025; the 2030 outcome is not yet due.
evidence: Tencent reports 48.5% green electricity in 2025, against its 100% target for 2030.

promise: Provide up to €150 billion in defence-industry loans to member states through the SAFE instrument
description: The Council adopted SAFE on May 27, 2025, allowing up to EUR150 billion in loans on demand against approved national plans through 2030. By April 2026 it had authorized funding for 18 member states.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: Council approvals do not establish the amounts actually disbursed; the financing window remains open.

role: UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on HIV/AIDS
promise: Political Declaration on HIV/AIDS: 'United to End AIDS by 2030' - end AIDS as a public health threat by 2030
description: A large majority of UN member states adopted the June 23, 2026 political declaration reaffirming the goal of ending AIDS as a public-health threat by 2030. Adoption is not achievement of the health target.
evidence: WHO's June 24 report identifies the previous day's adoption and the 2030 goal.

promise: Mobilize funding for Gavi's 2026-2030 strategy to immunize 500 million children and avert an estimated 8-9 million future deaths
description: Gavi launched its investment opportunity on June 20, 2024. The June 25, 2025 summit secured more than $9 billion in pledges toward an $11.9 billion strategy budget. Pledges are not cash receipts, and modeled future deaths averted are not completed outcomes.
evidence: Funding pledges advanced the programme, but 2026-2030 immunization delivery and modeled benefits remain prospective.

promise: Plan, as conditions stood in April 2021, to make Cadillac an EV-only brand by 2030
description: Cadillac's April 21, 2021 statement presented an EV-only 2030 plan with an explicit current-conditions qualification. July 2026 reporting confirmed renewed gasoline-model plans.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: renewed gasoline models weaken the trajectory, but the retrieved evidence does not establish the final 2030 sales mix or a definitive cancellation of that specific deadline.
sources: Car and Driver: gasoline model plans

promise: Make the entire Rolls-Royce Motor Cars product portfolio fully electric by 2030
description: Rolls-Royce announced full portfolio electrification by 2030 on September 29, 2021. In March 2026, CEO Chris Brownridge publicly abandoned the target.
evidence: The target was expressly withdrawn, rather than merely remaining incomplete before its deadline.

role: South Korean shipbuilder and engine maker
promise: Invest KRW 1.0722 trillion in engine and SMR-component facilities, supporting a target of 7.2 GW annual HiMSEN capacity by 2030
description: The September 10, 2026 disclosure allocates KRW 833.6 billion to the engine facility and KRW 238.6 billion to SMR components. It targets engine-plant completion in May 2028, SMR completion in first-half 2029 and total engine capacity of 7.2 GW by 2030.
evidence: The company release states separate facility schedules and a 2030 combined marine and land-based engine-capacity target.

promise: Invest more than $2 billion in Latin American programming and sports rights between 2027 and 2030
description: Prime Video said it would spend more than $2 billion on original and licensed programming and live sports rights across Latin America between 2027 and 2030, more than doubling its local original output across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Chile and releasing more than 25 new titles in 2027 alone.
evidence: Announcement of August 20, 2026
Commitment covers 2027-2030 across five Latin American markets

role: Indian subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Group
promise: Reach 20 percent women in its executive workforce by 2030
description: Hyundai Motor India announced a target on September 7, 2026 for women to represent 20% of its executive workforce by 2030.
evidence: The company announcement supports the date, target, denominator and 2030 horizon.
